pick.headline: Bani-Sadr escapes Iran to Paris with Rajavi
pick.fbis: The Middle East & Africa Daily Report of July 29, 1981, led its Iran review with Paris radio reporting that Bani-Sadr's plane had landed at Evreux and France had granted asylum on condition of no political activity, while Tehran radio said he had joined the counterrevolution.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 145, 29 July 1981

alternates.headline: Gorbachev announces a unilateral nuclear test moratorium
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of July 30, 1985, opened its arms control section with Gorbachev's announcement of a nuclear explosion moratorium, from PRAVDA, followed by items awaiting a US response, and a late report on the US reply.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, Vol. III No. 146, 30 July 1985
